message.onepiece.second_fruit: Your body cannot hold two Devil Fruit powers...
fruit.onepiece.gomu_gomu_no_mi.desc: Rubber body: no fall damage, immune to lightning, and your punches send enemies flying.
fruit.onepiece.ope_ope_no_mi.desc: Swap places with whatever you look at, or operate on yourself to heal.
fruit.onepiece.bara_bara_no_mi.desc: Split your body apart: some attacks pass through you, and you can fire your fists.
fruit.onepiece.gura_gura_no_mi.desc: Shatter the air itself to make quakes that blast enemies away.
fruit.onepiece.soru_soru_no_mi.desc: Steal life from your enemies and call down Zeus's lightning.
fruit.onepiece.jiki_jiki_no_mi.desc: Magnetism: throw enemies away, or pull every dropped item to you.
fruit.onepiece.wara_wara_no_mi.desc: Curse enemies with straw dolls and let them take your damage.
fruit.onepiece.toshi_toshi_no_mi.desc: Control age: turn mobs into babies, or age yourself up to get stronger.
fruit.onepiece.ito_ito_no_mi.desc: Strings: hold enemies in the air like puppets and swing through the sky.
fruit.onepiece.mero_mero_no_mi.desc: Love beams turn enemies to stone so they can't move.
fruit.onepiece.nikyu_nikyu_no_mi.desc: Paw pads push anything away, including yourself across the land.
fruit.onepiece.kage_kage_no_mi.desc: Steal shadows to blind enemies and grow stronger.
fruit.onepiece.zushi_zushi_no_mi.desc: Control gravity to crush enemies into the ground.
fruit.onepiece.mochi_mochi_no_mi.desc: Sticky mochi glues enemies in place, and some hits sink right through you.
fruit.onepiece.fuku_fuku_no_mi.desc: Fox fire sword slashes, and outfits that work like armor.
fruit.onepiece.nomi_nomi_no_mi.desc: A giant brain: see every creature around you, and learn instantly.
fruit.onepiece.hana_hana_no_mi.desc: Sprout arms anywhere to grab and hold enemies.
fruit.onepiece.yomi_yomi_no_mi.desc: Come back to life once every 10 minutes, and chill enemies with your soul.
fruit.onepiece.mera_mera_no_mi.desc: Become fire: you can't burn, attacks often pass through you, and Hiken sets enemies ablaze.
fruit.onepiece.hie_hie_no_mi.desc: Become ice: the sea freezes under your feet, and you can freeze everything around you.
fruit.onepiece.yami_yami_no_mi.desc: Darkness: pull enemies in like a black hole.
fruit.onepiece.suna_suna_no_mi.desc: Become sand: attacks pass through you, and your sandstorms dry enemies out.
fruit.onepiece.magu_magu_no_mi.desc: Become magma: you can't burn, and your attacks hit harder than fire.
fruit.onepiece.pika_pika_no_mi.desc: Become light: travel at light speed and fire laser beams.
fruit.onepiece.mori_mori_no_mi.desc: Become a forest: drain enemies with roots and make plants grow.
fruit.onepiece.moku_moku_no_mi.desc: Become smoke: blind enemies and float through the air.
fruit.onepiece.goro_goro_no_mi.desc: Become lightning: you can't be shocked, and you call bolts down wherever you look.
fruit.onepiece.hito_hito_no_mi.desc: Rumble Ball makes you stronger, and as a doctor you can heal your friends.
item.onepiece.hito_hito_no_mi_daibutsu: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu
Become a giant golden Buddha and send out shockwaves.
item.onepiece.uo_uo_no_mi_seiryu: Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu
fruit.onepiece.uo_uo_no_mi_seiryu.desc: Become an Azure Dragon that floats through the sky and breathes fire.
item.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_allosaurus: Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Allosaurus
Become an Allosaurus with crushing jaws.
item.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_pteranodon: Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Pteranodon
Become a Pteranodon and soar through the sky.
item.onepiece.neko_neko_no_mi_leopard: Neko Neko no Mi, Model: Leopard
fruit.onepiece.neko_neko_no_mi_leopard.d: Become a leopard: fast, strong, and deadly when you pounce.
item.onepiece.tori_tori_no_mi_phoenix: Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix
fruit.onepiece.tori_tori_no_mi_phoenix.d: Become a Phoenix: blue flames heal you and your friends.
item.onepiece.inu_inu_no_mi_okuchi_no_ma: Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi no Makami
fruit.onepiece.inu_inu_no_mi_okuchi_no_m: Become the wolf god: fast, strong, and your breath freezes enemies.
message.onepiece.ate_fruit: You ate the %s! But the sea will never accept you now.
message.onepiece.power_key_hint: Press R to use your power. Sneak and press R for your second move.
message.onepiece.no_fruit: You haven't eaten a Devil Fruit.
message.onepiece.yomi_revive: Your Devil Fruit brings you back from the dead!
item.onepiece.cooked_sea_king_meat: Sea King Meat on the Bone
fruit.onepiece.numa_numa_no_mi.desc: Become a bottomless swamp: drag enemies in and sink them in place.
fruit.onepiece.gasu_gasu_no_mi.desc: Become poison gas: choke enemies and fill the air with poison.
fruit.onepiece.yuki_yuki_no_mi.desc: Become snow: you can't freeze, and your blizzards freeze everything around you.
fruit.onepiece.horo_horo_no_mi.desc: Make ghosts: Negative Hollows drain the will to fight right out of enemies.
fruit.onepiece.bisu_bisu_no_mi.desc: Make hard biscuits: punch hard and wear biscuit armor (it's tasty too).
fruit.onepiece.pero_pero_no_mi.desc: Make candy: seal enemies in hard candy.
fruit.onepiece.mira_mira_no_mi.desc: Make mirrors: step through the Mirror World and vanish from sight.
fruit.onepiece.netsu_netsu_no_mi.desc: Heat your body: you can't burn, and everything you touch catches fire.
fruit.onepiece.bari_bari_no_mi.desc: Make unbreakable barriers: block almost any attack, or smash enemies with one.
fruit.onepiece.hobi_hobi_no_mi.desc: Turn enemies into helpless toys, and make everyone forget you.
fruit.onepiece.doru_doru_no_mi.desc: Make wax as hard as steel: lock enemies in place and wear wax armor.
fruit.onepiece.bomu_bomu_no_mi.desc: Turn any part of your body into a bomb. Explosions can't hurt you.
fruit.onepiece.kilo_kilo_no_mi.desc: Change your weight: float like a feather, then crush enemies at 10,000 kilos.
fruit.onepiece.supa_supa_no_mi.desc: Turn your body into steel blades.
fruit.onepiece.mane_mane_no_mi.desc: Copy anyone's face, so you can sneak around unseen.
fruit.onepiece.noro_noro_no_mi.desc: Noroma photons slow anything they hit to a crawl for 30 seconds.
fruit.onepiece.doa_doa_no_mi.desc: Make doors in anything: walk straight through walls, or hide inside the air.
fruit.onepiece.awa_awa_no_mi.desc: Soap bubbles wash away an enemy's strength.
fruit.onepiece.fuwa_fuwa_no_mi.desc: Make anything float, including enemies and yourself.
fruit.onepiece.ishi_ishi_no_mi.desc: Merge with stone: giant stone fists and a rock-hard body.
fruit.onepiece.hira_hira_no_mi.desc: Make anything flutter like a flag, so steel goes soft.
fruit.onepiece.nagi_nagi_no_mi.desc: Erase all sound around you and sneak up on anyone.
fruit.onepiece.horu_horu_no_mi.desc: Control hormones: wink enemies away and pump yourself up to heal.
fruit.onepiece.doku_doku_no_mi.desc: Make deadly poison. Poison can't hurt you.
fruit.onepiece.bane_bane_no_mi.desc: Turn your legs into springs and bounce around at crazy speed.
fruit.onepiece.kira_kira_no_mi.desc: Turn your body into diamond, the hardest thing there is.
fruit.onepiece.woshu_woshu_no_mi.desc: Wash enemies like laundry until all their strength is gone.
fruit.onepiece.oto_oto_no_mi.desc: Turn your body into instruments: sound waves cut from far away.
fruit.onepiece.shiro_shiro_no_mi.desc: Your body is a fortress full of cannons.
fruit.onepiece.baku_baku_no_mi.desc: Eat anything, and get stronger from what you eat.
fruit.onepiece.choki_choki_no_mi.desc: Your fingers become scissors that cut anything like paper.
fruit.onepiece.fude_fude_no_mi.desc: Your drawings come to life: blind enemies with ink and draw an iron golem to fight for you.
fruit.onepiece.kibi_kibi_no_mi.desc: Make kibi dango that tame any animal, or calm angry mobs.
fruit.onepiece.toki_toki_no_mi.desc: Travel through time: jump ahead in a blink and move faster than time.
fruit.onepiece.memo_memo_no_mi.desc: Pull memories out of people's heads and edit them, so enemies forget they were fighting you.
fruit.onepiece.wapu_wapu_no_mi.desc: Teleport yourself, or send enemies flying high into the sky.
fruit.onepiece.beta_beta_no_mi.desc: Sticky mucus traps enemies, and it burns.
fruit.onepiece.pamu_pamu_no_mi.desc: Make things swell up and burst.
fruit.onepiece.sui_sui_no_mi.desc: Swim through the ground and walls like water.
fruit.onepiece.buki_buki_no_mi.desc: Turn any part of your body into a weapon.
fruit.onepiece.guru_guru_no_mi.desc: Spin your body like a propeller to fight and fly.
fruit.onepiece.modo_modo_no_mi.desc: Take years away from anything you touch.
fruit.onepiece.sube_sube_no_mi.desc: Super-smooth skin: many attacks slide right off you.
fruit.onepiece.ori_ori_no_mi.desc: Bind enemies with iron bars made from your arms.
fruit.onepiece.nui_nui_no_mi.desc: Stitch anything together, even enemies to the ground.
fruit.onepiece.ton_ton_no_mi.desc: Make yourself weigh tons and crush what's below.
fruit.onepiece.ato_ato_no_mi.desc: Turn enemies into stiff, twisted works of art.
fruit.onepiece.sabi_sabi_no_mi.desc: Rust anything you touch, so enemies' weapons crumble.
fruit.onepiece.mato_mato_no_mi.desc: Anything you throw always hits its target, even around walls.
fruit.onepiece.mogu_mogu_no_mi.desc: Become a mole and tunnel straight through the ground.
fruit.onepiece.uma_uma_no_mi.desc: Become a horse and gallop at full speed.
item.onepiece.sara_sara_no_mi_axolotl: Sara Sara no Mi, Model: Axolotl
fruit.onepiece.sara_sara_no_mi_axolotl.d: Become a giant axolotl that heals fast and breathes poison gas.
item.onepiece.inu_inu_no_mi_wolf: Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Wolf
fruit.onepiece.inu_inu_no_mi_wolf.desc: Become a wolf: fast, strong, and fierce.
item.onepiece.inu_inu_no_mi_jackal: Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Jackal
fruit.onepiece.inu_inu_no_mi_jackal.desc: Become a jackal and pounce on enemies.
item.onepiece.neko_neko_no_mi_saber_tige: Neko Neko no Mi, Model: Saber Tiger
item.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_pachycephalo: Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Pachycephalosaurus
fruit.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_pachycephal: Become a dinosaur with a rock-hard skull.
item.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_triceratops: Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Triceratops
fruit.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_triceratops: Become a triceratops and charge with your horns.
item.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_spinosaurus: Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Spinosaurus
fruit.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_spinosaurus: Become a spinosaurus, a giant river-hunting dinosaur.
item.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_brachiosauru: Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Brachiosaurus
item.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_nidhogg: Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhogg
fruit.onepiece.ryu_ryu_no_mi_nidhogg.des: Become Nidhogg, the world-tree dragon of giant legend: a winged dragon-man that calls down thunder.
item.onepiece.zou_zou_no_mi_mammoth: Zou Zou no Mi, Model: Mammoth
fruit.onepiece.zou_zou_no_mi.desc: Become an elephant (in the story, Spandam's sword ate this one).
item.onepiece.ushi_ushi_no_mi_giraffe: Ushi Ushi no Mi, Model: Giraffe
fruit.onepiece.ushi_ushi_no_mi_giraffe.d: Become a giraffe and swing your neck like a hammer.
item.onepiece.ushi_ushi_no_mi_bison: Ushi Ushi no Mi, Model: Bison
fruit.onepiece.ushi_ushi_no_mi_bison.des: Become a bison and charge through enemies.
item.onepiece.tori_tori_no_mi_falcon: Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Falcon
fruit.onepiece.tori_tori_no_mi_falcon.de: Become a falcon and soar through the sky.
item.onepiece.hebi_hebi_no_mi_anaconda: Hebi Hebi no Mi, Model: Anaconda
Become a giant anaconda and squeeze enemies.
item.onepiece.hebi_hebi_no_mi_king_cobra: Hebi Hebi no Mi, Model: King Cobra
fruit.onepiece.hebi_hebi_no_mi_king_cobr: Become a king cobra with deadly venom.
item.onepiece.hebi_hebi_no_mi_yamata_no_: Hebi Hebi no Mi, Model: Yamata no Orochi
fruit.onepiece.hebi_hebi_no_mi_yamata_no: Become an eight-headed serpent. Like Orochi, you come back to life once every 10 minutes.
item.onepiece.inu_inu_no_mi_kyubi_no_kit: Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Kyubi no Kitsune
fruit.onepiece.inu_inu_no_mi_kyubi_no_ki: Become a nine-tailed fox that can copy anyone perfectly.
item.onepiece.kumo_kumo_no_mi_rosamygale: Kumo Kumo no Mi, Model: Rosamygale Grauvogeli
fruit.onepiece.kumo_kumo_no_mi_rosamygal: Become a giant ancient spider and trap enemies in webs.
message.onepiece.mastery_max: Your Devil Fruit mastery is complete. Beat %s different story bosses, then survive the brink of death to awaken it...
message.onepiece.awakened_hint: Press Y to enter your awakened form. Your fruit also got a permanent boost.
